answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake above the reward one epoch can pay out, and the bond is slashed if its attestations fail verification. A newcomer also starts with zero reputation weight and can only build it over a long horizon of honest epochs, so a thousand cloned agents in a grove of fake nodes would need a thousand simultaneous bonds plus the same waiting period. Every fake identity costs real locked capital and earns nothing until it survives that horizon, turning the tundra of Sybil clones into a pure capital bill.
